title: feat(enter): allow up to 365 days on earnings endpoints
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Allow up to 365 days on both earnings endpoints, matching earnings-event retention.
- Keep usage-history endpoints capped at 90 days.
- Add focused boundary tests for both earnings routes.

Addresses #12771 (earnings history only; the leaderboard remains open).
Fixes #15415

gist.headline: A year of honey receipts
gist.blurb: Earnings history can now stretch across a full 365 days, matching how long the event ledger keeps its pollen. Usage history remains a tidy 90-day window, because not every drawer needs to become an attic.
gist.summary: Both account earnings endpoints now accept up to 365 days of history, matching earnings-event retention, while usage-history endpoints remain capped at 90 days.
gist.impact: Creators and developers can retrieve a full year of earnings data from the API without splitting their reporting into shorter date ranges.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful beekeeper-accountant in a cozy garden shed, opening a year-long honey ledger beside a retro terminal showing an earnings chart. A calendar with four gentle seasons and a 365-day label represents the expanded range, while a smaller 90-day usage notebook sits nearby; code-plants and flowers keep the scene rooted in the hive.
